nodes.description: Private mapping of address to token balance, mutated by _transfer and _burn.
Private nested mapping of owner to spender allowances, mutated by _approve and read by increase/decreaseAllowance.
Public mapping marking sender addresses exempt from the burn-on-transfer mechanism.
Public mapping marking recipient addresses exempt from the burn-on-transfer mechanism.
Total token supply, reduced inside _burn via SafeMath.sub.
Configurable burn percentage (default 5) settable by owner through setBurnPercent and used in _burnPerTransfer.
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards _msgSender(), recipient and amount to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens, decreases allowance and conditionally applies burn via _burnPerTransfer.
Public ERC20 approve that delegates to _approve for _msgSender and spender.
Public function that increases spender allowance using SafeMath.add.
Public function that decreases spender allowance using SafeMath.sub.
Internal transfer logic that updates _balances and triggers burn when not whitelisted.
Internal burn logic reducing _balances[account] and _totalSupply.
Owner-restricted public burn entry point delegating to _burn.
Owner-restricted setter for the burnPercent state variable.
Owner-restricted setter updating whitelistTo mapping.
Owner-restricted setter updating whitelistFrom mapping.
Internal helper computing amount * burnPercent / 100 and invoking _burn.
Internal view checking whitelistFrom[_from] or whitelistTo[_to].
Caller-controlled address used via _msgSender for allowances, balances and whitelist checks.
Unchecked multiplication amount * burnPercent then division by 100 performed without SafeMath.
Access-control gated burn function relying on the onlyOwner modifier.
Access-control gated setBurnPercent function allowing owner to change burn rate arbitrarily.
Caller-supplied token amount parameter of transferFrom.
Local variable holding amount * burnPercent / 100 inside _burnPerTransfer.
Target account parameter of the owner-restricted burn function.

edges.reason: transfer delegates token movement to the internal _transfer function.
transfer passes _msgSender() (msg.sender) as the sender argument to _transfer.
transferFrom calls the internal _transfer function.
transferFrom invokes _burnPerTransfer when addresses are not whitelisted.
transferFrom queries _isWhitelisted to decide whether to burn.
Caller-supplied amount parameter flows into transferFrom logic and burn calculation.
approve writes the allowance into the _allowances state mapping.
increaseAllowance reads and writes _allowances values.
decreaseAllowance reads and writes _allowances values.
_transfer mutates _balances for sender and recipient.
_transfer calls _burnPerTransfer when whitelist check passes.
_transfer checks _isWhitelisted(msg.sender, recipient).
_transfer uses msg.sender in the whitelist check for burning.
burn delegates destruction of tokens to _burn.
burn is protected only by the onlyOwner modifier which must guard privileged token destruction.
setBurnPercent writes owner-controlled percent into burnPercent state variable.
setBurnPercent is restricted by onlyOwner allowing the owner to alter burn economics.
setWhitelistedTo writes owner-controlled flag into whitelistTo.
setWhitelistedFrom writes owner-controlled flag into whitelistFrom.
_burnPerTransfer calls _burn to destroy the computed amount.
_burnPerTransfer executes unchecked multiplication and division arithmetic on amount and burnPercent.
Local calculate value derived from amount * burnPercent / 100 flows into _burn.
The unsafe arithmetic produces the calculate local variable without SafeMath protection.
_burn decreases _balances[account] using SafeMath.sub.
_burn decreases the _totalSupply state variable.
_burn reads the account parameter supplied by the caller of burn.
_isWhitelisted reads whitelistFrom[_from].
_isWhitelisted reads whitelistTo[_to].
Caller-controlled msg.sender influences while executing _transfer whitelist and burn decisions.
